userSecrets.bannerBodyOne: {{count}} user secret you are responsible for has no value yet. Runs that require it will fail until you set your value.
userSecrets.bannerBodyOther: {{count}} user secrets you are responsible for have no value yet. Runs that require them will fail until you set your value.
userSecrets.setDescription: This value is yours only. It is used when you are the user responsible for a run that needs {{key}}.
userSecrets.externalHelp: Points at your own credential in the configured provider. Paperclip stores the reference, not the value.
userSecrets.valueHelp: Stored encrypted. Never shown back to anyone, including admins.
userSecrets.intro: These are credentials only you provide. Each value is yours alone — used when you are the user responsible for a run — and is never shown back to anyone, including admins.
userSecrets.missingOne: {{count}} required secret still needs your value.
userSecrets.missingOther: {{count}} required secrets still need your value.
userSecrets.empty: No user secrets are defined for this organization yet. An admin defines which credentials each member supplies.
userSecrets.definitionsIntro: Define credentials that each member supplies for themselves. You set the shape here; every user enters their own value under My secrets. Coverage shows how many members have set a value — never the values themselves.
userSecrets.definitionsEmpty: No user secret definitions yet. Create one to require each member to supply their own credential.
userSecrets.membersSupply: Members supply their own value for this credential. No value is entered here.
userSecrets.keyHelp: Stable identifier referenced by env bindings.
userSecrets.usagePlaceholder: Tell members how to create their token, required scopes, etc.
userSecrets.removeBody: This removes the definition {{key}} for the whole company. Existing member values become unreferenced. This cannot be undone.

proposals.emptyMessage: When an agent proposes a secret or an access binding, it shows up here for review.
proposals.intro: Agents propose credentials and access bindings; you approve or reject them here. Proposed values are never shown — only a fingerprint and length.
proposals.approveCreateBody: The value is created as the proposing agent recorded it. Re-folder or rename it before it lands.
proposals.approveBindingBody: Grant the target agent access to this secret. This runs with your permissions.
proposals.cascadeBody: Also approve the proposed secret {{name}} and create it in the same step. The binding can’t land without it.
proposals.rejectBody: The reason is sent back to the proposing agent. Dependent bindings are rejected too.
proposals.approveBlocked: You don’t have permission to approve this.
